episodes.title: The Man Who Claimed to Be God | From Cult Leader to Fake Country |
episodes.description:
The Self-Proclaimed God Who Scammed the World

What happens when a spiritual guru claims to possess divine powers, builds a massive following, and eventually declares his own country?

This is the shocking and controversial story of Nithyananda, the self-proclaimed spiritual leader who announced the creation of a country called United States of Kailasa.

From his rise as a spiritual guru in India to serious allegations, legal controversies, and his mysterious disappearance from public view, this story reveals a bizarre chapter in the world of modern spiritual movements.

But the biggest mystery is Kailasa itself. How can a country have its own flag, passport, constitution, currency, and government when its territorial status is disputed?

In this documentary, we explore:

The rise of Nithyananda and his spiritual empire

His claims of supernatural and divine powers

The controversies and allegations surrounding him

The mysterious creation of the United States of Kailasa

Kailasa's claims of international recognition and its appearances in international headlines

The controversy surrounding its representation at the United Nations

Questions about land agreements, funding, and the future of Kailasa

The psychology of blind faith, spiritual authority, and religious deception

This is more than just the story of one man. It raises a bigger question: When does faith become blind devotion, and how can people distinguish genuine spirituality from manipulation?

Watch until the end to understand the story behind Nithyananda and the country that captured international attention.

episodes.title: THE INTERNET'S MOST DANGEROUS CULT | 764 |
episodes.description:
Behind the screens of Discord lies a disturbing online world where vulnerable teenagers become targets of manipulation, blackmail, and psychological abuse.

Known as 764, this online network gained notoriety for exploiting children, forcing victims into disturbing acts, and turning their suffering into trophies. At the center of this story are Felix, the founder of 764, and Rohan, a leader associated with another notorious online group.

How did a teenager build such a disturbing online network? How did 764 recruit its victims, and why did it attract the attention of the FBI?

In this documentary, we explore the origins of 764, its connections to other online groups, the disturbing stories of its victims, and the investigations that exposed its activities.

Watch till the end to understand the dark reality of the 764 cult.
